title: the DEV TOOLS QR tool draws codes that a phone camera reads

clauses.text: the DEV TOOLS QR tool draws codes that a phone camera reads

steps.do: Open DEV TOOLS, QR code. Make a text code, a Wi-Fi code and a URL code and point a phone camera at each.
steps.expect: The phone reads each code back to the text typed and the code has a quiet zone and black on white.
